objections.claim: A module-level mutable roles holder cannot isolate concurrent requests.
objections.evidence: HOW sets currentRoles on request entry and has every downstream helper read the module global directly.
objections.predicted_consequence: When requests with different roles interleave, the later request overwrites currentRoles and a helper in the earlier request authorises work using the other caller's roles.
